_about: Survey layer maps for the Fase 1 engine (c300-build-spec.mjs, c300-road-labels.mjs). Each surveyor names the layers of its X-TOPO differently; the engine reads the roles below instead of hard-coded names. Selected automatically by scripts/lib/survey-profile.mjs: the first profile whose centerline layer holds LINE entities in the site window wins (order matters: 'default' first so VILLA ONE / Goulds never change). A project can force one with project.json sources.surveyProfile. Added 2026-10-25 for the FormTech topo of SEIDENSTEIN (7421 SW 53 CT).

formtech.label: FormTech Land Surveying topo (job 26-090801, SEIDENSTEIN)
formtech._note: plLines/rwLines: parcels are metes-and-bounds pieces of a platted tract, so the county plat-lot layer has no shared edges: the PL symbols go on the survey's own lot lines (plLines, those running along an rwLines line are the frontage and get none). R/W half-width dims (25.00', 20', 50') are DIMENSION entities on TEXT / DIMLINE, one end on the lot line (LOTLINE/BNDRY) or the R/W line, the other on the CL. Pavement edge = PAVEM (LINE/ARC/SPLINE pieces). TEXT and DIMLINE also hold survey text/leaders: freezing them is decided per project after looking at the plot, so freezeXrefLayers stays as the default until then.

hidePavementLabels.note: SOD / PAVERS APPROACH+WALK / CONC. WALK / CONCRETE APPROACH / PARKWAY / ASPHALT / ASPHALT APPROACH callouts + their arrows -> layer HIDE-PAVEMENT-LABELS (frozen). mode all = user's current rule (2026-10-25); mode property keeps only those on the property side of the street (needs project.json sources.pavementKeep {x,y0,y1}); mode none = leave them. Override per project with project.json sources.pavementLabels.
